title: Trend Micro Deep Security Agent Manual Scan Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trend Micro Deep Security Agent. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Trend Micro Deep Security Notifier service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
